title: Congratulations to Guilherme Leitão on his MSc defense!
body_html: Guilherme successfully defended his MSc thesis, exploring defenses against adversarial attacks on AI-driven self-driving networks as part of DEPT / IRON. Congratulations, Guilherme, and all the best for what comes next!

title: New Peregrine revision on arXiv
body_html: Our updated paper, Where to Sample: Rethinking ML-Based Malicious Traffic Detection at Terabit Scale, is now on arXiv. Peregrine computes ML features over all packets before sampling, preserving detection effectiveness while reducing the data sent to software inference.
image_alt: Peregrine computes ML features before sampling

title: A new reading course on networks and distributed systems
body_html: This semester, I am teaching Advanced Topics in Networked Distributed Systems: a paper-based course exploring networks, distributed systems, and their intersection with AI.

title: CoNEXT 2027 PC co-chair
body_html: I am co-chairing the technical program committee of ACM CoNEXT 2027 with Gyuyeong Kim. The call for papers is available—we look forward to your submissions!
image_alt: Rio de Janeiro, host city of CoNEXT 2027

title: SmartNIC programming tutorial at SIGCOMM 2026
body_html: I co-organised Programming SmartNICs: From Packet Processing to Programmable Transport at SIGCOMM 2026, with hands-on sessions on packet processing and programmable transport. Explore the BlueField-3 tutorial and hands-on materials.

title: Helping organise EuroP4 2026
body_html: I am helping organise EuroP4 2026 as a member of its steering committee. The workshop takes place on 7 December alongside CoNEXT 2026 in Utrecht.
